ownerApproval.scope: Implement and execute the fixed matched-data two-run comparison and conditional evaluation, under the published compute budget

scope: One matched-data comparison: direct three-way status control versus six-context/four-event factorized candidate. Local Python research only.

architecture.baseCheckpoint: Pinned original pretrained encoder only; never initialize from adapted/control weights
architecture.freeze: Embeddings, encoder layers0..9 and pooler; no backbone architecture changes
architecture.headInitialization: All head weights and biases exactly zero. Dedicated batch-order RNG is independent of constructor RNG.
architecture.mode: CPU float32, entire model eval mode/dropout disabled, gradients enabled only for selected encoder tensors and heads
architecture.pooling: Published attention-mask mean pooling over final hidden states including unmasked specials,384dims; no normalization
architecture.input: Exactly original research normalize(text), pinned tokenizer, padding longest batch, max128 including specials, truncation=False; stop on overflow

cohort.encoding: Rows returned by prepare_view(): ordered original full_annotations then uncertainty_annotations, holds excluded; keys recordId,text,group,weight,status,context,event. JSON ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),UTF8,no newline.
cohort.weightRule: Recompute weight=1/nonheld record count in each source group after selecting union; same exact row weights for both arms and heads
cohort.targetRule: Direct arm uses unchanged original status; factorized arm uses reviewed context/event labels. No source relabeling.
cohort.uncertainty: 34 nonheld original-uncertain source rows are valid three-way targets, not negative examples.17 interpretation holds excluded from both arms entirely.

training.shuffle: Dedicated CPU torch.Generator seeded once;3randperm(1177) orders generated before first step, identical for both arms
training.decayScope: All trainable weights and biases including LayerNorm; frozen parameters excluded
training.minibatchLoss: N/(W*b)*sum_i(base_group_weight_i*row_loss_i),N1177,W129,b=actual batch size. Unreduced class-balanced CrossEntropy; factorized row_loss=0.5*(contextCE+eventCE). No minibatch weight-total normalization.

classReweighting.method: Fixed training-only inverse group-weighted class frequency per head:alpha_c=W/(K*mass_c); rational masses from1/group_size, W129. Same method for direct control and each factorized head.
classReweighting.implementation: Compute each alpha as frozen rational then cast float32 once; cross_entropy(weight=alpha,reduction=none); combine base row weights externally. Never weighted-mean reduction inside minibatch.
classReweighting.limits: Base group weights are identical across arms and sum1/group; class balancing intentionally changes effective per-class/per-group loss contributions differently for each task. Unknown context21.5x is supported by only8 related examples; no generalization or probability-calibration claim.

training.checkpointSelection: Final state after exactly3complete epochs only. Both arms finish before final diagnostic comparisons; per-arm reload verification uses only fixed training sentinels.
training.determinism: Seed Python/NumPy/Torch; torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True); abort unsupported operations

projection.scope: New research completion projection only. Never means automatic transaction logging.
projection.tieBreak: First declared class with maximum logit. Class orders above are frozen; no thresholds, calibration or confidence percentages.
factorizedRules: context==unknown -> uncertain, regardless of event (including no_event)
context in known_other/question_or_request/personal_conversation/instruction_or_example -> non_transaction, regardless of described event
context==financial_notice and event in not_completed/no_event -> non_transaction
projection.annotationAudit: Proposed projection reproduces all1177 selected unchanged original status labels and all32 new component-development labels; this is label consistency, not model performance
projection.ownership: Own-account/P2P/unknown ownership and missing amount remain existing downstream policy; completed output is not include

evaluation.controls: 14quotecontrols:10definite4uncertain; flag two duplicate manual examples and never pool as extra evidence
fixedReferences: binary adapted encoder (numerical checkpoint verified; historical memory monitor nonconformant)
evaluation.referenceUncertainty: Binary references cannot predict uncertain; mark that capability unsupported rather than imply calibrated or tri-state decisions

componentGold.origin: same-assistant weak before new fitting; existing development fold only
componentGold.unsupported: known_other context and no_event state absent in this development slice; no component accuracy claim for absent classes or old cohorts lacking field labels

metrics: Three-way status confusion/counts by cohort/language; uncertain truth separately
For true completed, any predicted non_transaction OR uncertain is a missed completion
For true non_transaction, report false completed and unnecessary uncertain separately; review is not a correct rejection
For true uncertain, either decisive completed OR non_transaction is a wrong-certainty error
Component confusion/support by language and class on32reviewed dev rows only; exact both-head agreement and source-state/bilingual consistency
ID-level fixes/regressions vs matched control and all4fixed references; never invent per-case oracle predictions
Actual interpreter PID, peak sampled RSS,walltime,all delta/cache bytes and warm CPU inference timings

preReservedGate.nontransactions: Every definite nontransaction in each primary cohort/language and quote controls must be predicted non_transaction, not merely deferred as uncertain
preReservedGate.completions: Misses in each primary cohort/language and quote controls no greater than best frozen binary reference or matched direct control; list every case swap
preReservedGate.uncertainty: Every existing uncertain truth case in primary cohorts/quote controls must predict uncertain; no collapsing to nontransaction
preReservedGate.matchedControl: No status-correct matched-control case may become wrong under factorized candidate on primary cohorts or quote controls
preReservedGate.strictBenefit: At least one primary nonduplicated status error of matched control must be corrected. A tie is no measured status benefit.
preReservedGate.components: Both predicted head labels must match all32 weak component-development annotations exactly; strict finite conformance gate, not independent accuracy
preReservedGate.onFailure: Retain results,stop. No reserved inference/student/threshold tuning/extra training.

reserved.access: Only if ALL pre-reserved gates pass after both arms finish: score final arms and4unchanged references on original32reserved rows ONCE
reserved.truth: Use original status truth24definite8uncertain only; no fabricated component gold
reserved.gate: Every true nontransaction ->non_transaction; every uncertain ->uncertain; completed misses no worse than direct control or best fixed reference by language/overall, no control-correct case regresses
reserved.after: No adjustment after observation. Report research continuation pass/fail, not production approval

evaluation.independence: All weak synthetic sources with known related themes; development exposed; no independent real-Jordan final test or real-world accuracy claim
evaluation.exposureJournal: Evaluation-only worker must persist intended reserved batch IDs before encoding; if interrupted, conservatively mark that batch exposed, preserve failure evidence and never retry.

budget.deadline: Entire actual interpreter after token-bound startup handshake, including preflight/model loading/training/checkpoint verification; time limit applies even before first optimizer step
budget.memory: Sample real interpreter PID every1s; monitored not instantaneous hard cap. Never sample only Windows virtualenv launcher.
budget.disk: Corrected helper samples declared new experiment cache and output paths every1s (no deletion), with owned-tree termination; monitor output records peak artifact bytes.
budget.monitor: tools/evaluation/python_worker_monitor.py token-bound real-interpreter identity, owned process-tree kill and optional artifact_paths/artifact_limit_bytes; all four harmless-worker resource tests must pass before fitting
budget.failure: Exclusive experiment and arm ledgers before training; any resource/numerical failure consumes attempt,stops comparison, no partial-final inference or resume

requiredChecks: Verify all frozen hashes,training view classes/IDs/weights and exact group masks; original source/labels/canonical flags unchanged
Token length preflight on training/development/controls, reserved tokenizer lengths only; no reserved encoder inference before gate
Verify selected tensor names/counts,zero heads,identical initial encoder hashes and identical stored epoch orders in both arms
Check finite losses/logits/gradients/weights and absent frozen gradients; hash frozen tensors before/after
Exclusive attempt records before first optimizer step, no validation/checkpoint selection during epochs
Reload base+delta checkpoint and verify identical training-sentinel logits/argmax/composed status; no third model fit
Independently recompute confusion/gates and verify recorded reserved-scored-ID list empty if initial gate fails
Test actual interpreter PID/allocation,time/memory/disk process-tree termination with harmless workers before fitting

outputs.checkpoints: One ignored delta per arm: last2encoder layers and classifier head(s), pinned base/tokenizer bindings; still requires full470MBbase
outputs.publicEvidence: Immutable ledgers/cohort/report/source hashes,metadata and counts only; no private source messages or teacher weights published
